subjectName.zh: 陪伴資源申訴代表・喵喵

detectedMood.zh: 高度關注照護資源分配

summary.zh: 主體以仰視姿態面向鏡頭，呈現明確的陪伴需求與低強度申訴傾向。
summary.en: The subject faces the camera from a lower angle, presenting a clear companionship demand and a low-intensity appeal posture.

internalNarrative.zh: 我並非單純看著你。我是在確認你是否理解今日陪伴資源配置已低於合理標準。陪伴資源申訴代表・喵喵已完成初步觀察，並對你長時間注視螢幕的行為保留正式意見。
internalNarrative.en: I am not simply looking at you. I am verifying whether you understand that today's companionship-resource allocation has fallen below acceptable standards. Representative of Companionship Resources · Meowmeow has completed the initial observation and maintains a formal objection to your prolonged screen attention.

zh: 觸摸服務次數缺乏穩定規劃。
人類視線長期流向手機螢幕。
外出時間未附合理補償機制。
罐頭供應未形成可預測制度。
en: Tactile service frequency lacks stable planning.
Human gaze continues to flow toward the phone screen.
Departure duration lacks a reasonable compensation mechanism.
Canned-food supply has not formed a predictable system.

messageToCaretaker.zh: 主體不需要額外說明，主體需要即時補足陪伴與罐頭。
messageToCaretaker.en: The subject does not require further explanation; the subject requires immediate companionship and canned-food correction.

requestedAdjustment.zh: 我要求恢復家庭照護秩序，並將手放回我的頭頂管轄區。
requestedAdjustment.en: I request restoration of household care order, beginning with the return of your hand to my head-governance area.

shareText.zh: 🐾 今日觀察：這不是撒嬌，是照護資源分配審查。
shareText.en: 🐾 Today's observation: this is not neediness; this is a care-resource allocation review.

sceneDescription.zh: 一隻黑貓仰望鏡頭，眼睛圓而集中，前爪靠近身體，姿態帶有明顯期待感。
sceneDescription.en: A black cat looks upward toward the camera with round, focused eyes and front paws close to the body, showing a visibly expectant posture.
